messages:
maria liu: Quick sync — planning rollout for the new routing+fallbacks feature for text-generation. Goal: safe regional canary -> staged expand -> A/B for cache settings. Need final decisions on canary size, metrics gating, and rollback triggers.
sam oneill: +1. my main ask: explicit SLA for p95 latency during canary. If p95 > 300ms for 5m we abort. Also want per-customer kill-switch.
devon choi: agree on SLA gate. For canary size propose 1% of EU traffic to start, then 5% after 30m, then 20% after 2h if all gates pass.
jia (prod): For observability gates we'll use: error-rate (5xx) spike > 0.5%, p95 latency regression > 20% vs baseline, and model-quality regressions from smoke prompts (>5% diff). All must be green.
maria liu: sounds good. How do we measure model-quality during canary? We have a lightweight eval harness but noisy.
devon choi: run shadow traffic against the new routing path and compute BLEU-like pass rates on the smoke set. Use a moving window of 1000 samples.
qa-jen: QA will run targeted prompts from enterprise customers that are sensitive to hallucinations. We'll have a quick manual review checklist for early canary.
sam oneill: feature flag config suggestion:
```json
{
  "flag": "routing_v2_canary",
  "scopes": ["region:eu"],
  "percent": 1,
  "customers": ["acct-1234"],
  "kill_switch": true
}
```
maria liu: nice. For staged regions: EU -> NA-west -> NA-east -> APAC (if legal/privacy checks pass). We should keep APAC as manual approve.
devon choi: Fallback policy: if canary fails, auto-fallback to previous routing variant and degrade to lower-cost model variant rather than full outage. Also enable degraded read-only mode for certain customers (configurable).
jia (prod): Agree; add automatic routing to Dedicated pool if Hosted capacity shows >85% GPU utilization for 10m. That avoids cross-tenant impact.
sam oneill: A/B tests: run a 50/50 A/B for cache TTL 30s vs 90s after stable rollout to measure cost/latency tradeoff. Need metric: tokens/sec per $ and p95 latency.
maria liu: Launch criteria checklist (draft):
- Monitoring hooks in place for all gates
- Canary config deployed and smoke harness enabled
- QA checklist signed off by 2 engineers + product
- Rollback script + operator runbook ready
- Customer opt-ins configured and communicated

Any other asks?
devon choi: Add a post-mortem template and a 24h watch rotation for first day.
qa-jen: I'll prepare the enterprise prompt set and a short runbook for manual checks.
maria liu: Great. @sam will you own the SLA gate boolean? @jia will you own the routing fallback automation?
sam oneill: I can own the SLA gate. I'll add alert playbooks to PagerDuty. :thumbsup: 
jia (prod): I'll own the fallback automation, will draft the runbook and the automated rollback lambda.
deploy-bot: deploy started: routing_v2_canary -> env=staging, id=deploy-20240401-09:12
maria liu: Thanks. We'll reconvene after first 30m of canary. If anything looks off ping #eng-oncall immediately.
sam oneill: I'll be on watch.
devon choi: logging note: capture the cache-hit ratio and KV cache size per-model during canary.
maria liu: Perfect. Closing for now — action items: sam add SLA gate, jia implement fallback lambda, qa-jen upload prompt set, devon instrument cache metrics. Report back in 30m. :rocket:
